design_request: 研究者依据建筑师任务说明构造的居住兼办公任务。此住宅供一位住户日常生活与在家工作，另需保留两人的用餐位置。办公资料可以留在工作面上，用餐时无需收走；办公区和餐区可辨识，同时办公位置与共同起居空间保持视觉联系。请完成工作面和坐席，并保留现有睡眠、起居、两餐位、冷藏、备餐、烹饪、水槽、淋浴、洗面盆、厕所、收纳及入口通行。可以增补家具并调整非固定家具，保留初始家具实例和尺寸，不删减必需用途；墙体、固定设施和床不改。不给定办公位置或推荐家具坐标。原住户原话不可得；人数、两餐位、资料持续占用、精确尺寸、初始家具和允许编辑范围均为研究假设。

structured_requirements.requirement: Retain bed and approach for one resident; actual comfort unknown.
Retain sofa and accessible sitting-side zone.
Retain table and two seats; do not displace them with a dedicated office.
Provide a work surface and seat; research40x30cm material patch must not overlap two declared dining-use zones.
Report geometric rays between work-seat proxy and sofa targets; do not equate to subjective openness.
Preserve refrigerator, preparation surface, cooker, sink and approaches.
Preserve shower, basin, toilet and approaches; privacy/operation unknown.
Keep bookshelf identity and front approach; capacity unknown.
Keep entrance, bedroom and bathroom approaches; no furniture intersections or outer-boundary violations.
Keep native state, assets, actual receipts, five views and reconstructible export.

geometry_assumptions.axes: Native centered XY, metres, Z up

unknowns: This is a 10x7m gross-envelope transfer, not the architect floorplan; shaft occupies 1.5x1.5m and partitions reduce usable area further. Original reported70m² has unknown area convention.
Original project furniture was bespoke; catalog substitutions do not reproduce it. Initial object identity is research-created, not historical owner identity.
No door leaves, utility installation, real sleeping/work comfort, storage volume, acoustic or daylight simulation.
Source supports living/work zones and visual continuity, not exact activities, occupant/guest counts, paper footprint or required sight-ray number.
Only geometric evaluation can be prepared locally; professional blind assessment and genuinely sealed project test remain unavailable.
